document.name: OrderedGridFixture
document.documentation: Kitchen Sink fixture for ordered collections that are saved: a data grid, an inline data grid and a list membership, whose rows (or members) can be dragged into a new order, kept by their ordinals.

collection.name: rows
collection.description: An ordered collection: its rows can be dragged into a new order.

collection.name: lines
collection.description: An ordered collection, edited inline: its rows can be dragged into a new order.

collection.name: members
collection.description: An ordered list membership of lookup values: its members can be dragged into a new order.
